title: A/B 测试与功能开关
html:
A/B 测试与功能开关

概述

本章聚焦 A/B 测试与功能开关，分为 A/B 测试基础、实验设计、功能开关、分析与决策四个部分。它帮助读者用英语描述实验方法、开关控制和结果判断，重点在实验设计与决策依据的准确表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合产品与研发沟通。建议把实验设计类词汇与分析决策术语结合学习，理解从假设到结论的完整流程。

A/B 测试基础

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
A/B test n. A/B测试 run an A/B test, A/B test results
control group n. 对照组 control group baseline, compare with control
treatment group n. 实验组 treatment group performance, expose treatment
hypothesis n. 假设 test a hypothesis, null hypothesis
statistical significance n. 统计显著性 reach significance, significance level
sample size n. 样本量 minimum sample size, calculate sample size

听说例句

A: Is the A/B test result statistically significant? B: Not yet. We need a larger sample size. The treatment group shows a 5% lift, but the confidence interval is too wide.

A: What was our hypothesis for this experiment? B: We hypothesized that simplifying the checkout form would increase conversion. The control group keeps the original design.

写作表达

  • The A/B test was designed with a clear hypothesis and a minimum sample size of 10,000 users per group.
  • Results reached statistical significance after 14 days, confirming a 12% improvement in the treatment group.

实验设计

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
variant n. 变体 test variant, variant A/B
metric n. 指标 primary metric, guardrail metric
guardrail n. 护栏指标 guardrail metric, set guardrails
segmentation n. 分组 user segmentation, segment by region
allocation n. 分配 traffic allocation, 50/50 allocation
duration n. 持续时间 experiment duration, minimum duration

听说例句

A: What's the traffic allocation for this experiment? B: 50/50 split. We're tracking conversion rate as the primary metric and crash rate as a guardrail.

A: How long should we run the experiment? B: At least two weeks to account for weekly patterns. We can segment by region if needed.

写作表达

  • The experiment uses a 50/50 traffic allocation with conversion rate as the primary metric and latency as a guardrail.
  • User segmentation by platform and region ensures that results are representative across all key demographics.

功能开关 (Feature Flags)

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
feature flag n. 功能开关 enable/disable feature flag, flag configuration
toggle v./n. 切换 toggle on/off, feature toggle
gradual rollout n. 灰度发布 gradual rollout strategy, rollout percentage
kill switch n. 紧急关闭 activate kill switch, kill switch mechanism
canary release n. 金丝雀发布 canary deployment, canary testing
dark launch n. 暗发布 dark launch mode, test in dark launch

听说例句

A: Should we use a feature flag for the new payment flow? B: Yes, start with a 5% gradual rollout. If anything goes wrong, we can activate the kill switch immediately.

A: What's the difference between a canary release and a dark launch? B: Canary exposes to a small percentage of real users. Dark launch runs the code path without showing it to users.

写作表达

  • Feature flags enable teams to decouple deployment from release, reducing the risk of large-scale failures.
  • The gradual rollout strategy starts at 1% and increases incrementally, with a kill switch ready for immediate rollback.

分析与决策

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
confidence interval n. 置信区间 95% confidence interval, narrow CI
p-value n. P值 p-value threshold, p < 0.05
lift n. 提升 percentage lift, observed lift
baseline n. 基线 baseline metric, compare against baseline
false positive n. 假阳性 risk of false positive, false positive rate
ship decision n. 上线决策 make a ship decision, ship or iterate

听说例句

A: The experiment shows a 3% lift, but the p-value is 0.08. B: That's above our 0.05 threshold. We can't make a confident ship decision yet. Let's extend the test.

A: Could this be a false positive? B: Possible, given the small effect size. We should check the confidence interval before deciding.

写作表达

  • The 95% confidence interval for the observed lift ranges from 1.5% to 4.2%, supporting a positive ship decision.
  • Extending the experiment duration reduces the risk of false positives and increases confidence in the results.
